Wind ka direction badal nahi sakta—par sails adjust kar sakta.
Soch lo, tum kar sakte ho ya nahi.
Jo peechhe hai aur jo aage hai—dono ko cover kar sakta.
"Motivation start karwati hai."
Jo nahi kar sakte, usse jo kar sakte ho—mat roko.
Maine sapne nahi dekhe, mehnat ki hai.
Self-mastery hi real power hai.
Discontent hi progress ka pehla step hai.
Thakne par mat ruko, kaam khatam hone par ruko.
Samajhdaar bano.
"Life change hoti jab tum naya, consistent decision lete."
Mistakes se darrna nahi; jaldi seekho.
